Definition: Whether the Ministry of Finance has oversight of the financing and development of the digital ID system
Comments: No evidence found regarding Ministry of Finance oversight of the digital ID system.
redteam_note: Scored 0/Unknown with no source — confirm it is truly unknown, not just unresearched. No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: A light check found that Comoros's National Digital Development Agency (ANADEN), which leads the country's broader digital transformation strategy (Comores Numerique 2028) and receives AfDB financing (the PADEC project, US$10.34m), is subject to financial oversight by the Ministry of Finance, Budget and Banking, per ANADEN's own site. However, operational responsibility for the national ID card/biometric passport system itself sits with the Ministry of Interior, which oversaw the 2026 contract transition from Semlex to GenKey, and no source directly confirms Ministry of Finance oversight of the ID system's financing specifically, as distinct from general digital-economy oversight. Evidence is suggestive but not conclusive; flagged for human review rather than upgrading the score.
revised_comments: The National Digital Development Agency (ANADEN), which leads Comoros's digital transformation strategy, is subject to financial oversight by the Ministry of Finance, Budget and Banking, while the national identity card and biometric passport system is administered separately by the Ministry of Interior. No source directly confirms Ministry of Finance oversight of the digital ID system's financing specifically.

Definition: Percentage of eligible population that has been issued or registered with digital ID credentials
Comments: No reliable population coverage statistics are available. The system is mandatory for nationals at age 18+ but operational gaps (centralised printing in Moroni only until 2026, civil registration weaknesses) have limited actual coverage. No ID4D or official figures found.

revision_notes: A light check identified that the World Bank's Global Findex 2025 database (fieldwork 2024) includes a new ID4D module with an indicator (fin48_a, 'Has a national identity card, % age 15+') that should cover Comoros, but the DataBank query interface did not return an extractable figure for Comoros within a light search, and the G20 Financial Inclusion Indicators country page listed the relevant fields as queryable without displaying a value directly. This is a promising, authoritative lead that has not been fully chased down; flagged for human review to pull the exact Comoros figure from World Bank DataBank rather than guessing a value code.
revised_comments: Reliable population coverage figures for Comoros's digital ID system are not confirmed. The World Bank's Global Findex 2025 survey, fielded in 2024, includes an Identification for Development (ID4D) module measuring national identity card ownership among adults, which may provide a coverage estimate for Comoros once the underlying country-level data is retrieved.
